text:
pav: Noticed a cluster of OOM alerts on kv-cache shard-22 during early-morning deployment window. Root looks similar to previous kv-frag incidents but with larger transient allocations. Opening a follow-up thread to track remediation items.

micah: Thanks. I pulled a heap profile and the top line is still large temp buffers in the write path. Attaching cropped pprof: `alloc_objects: InsertBatcher -> 34%`, `small-slices -> 26%`.

lena: Can we short-term mitigate with a soft cap on batch size while we investigate? We don't want large single-request spikes.

jorge: I can take batch size cap. Quick fix: add server-side clamp for Put batches > 8MB -> split into N. I'll PR for fast-track. ETA 3h.

adarsh: I'll take a stab at GC + compaction tuning. Hypothesis: fragmentation emerges when many short-lived objects interleave with a few very large ones, leaving free segments too small to reuse. Plan: enable compact-on-gc for a canary and measure impact. Need a controlled canary window. ETA: tomorrow morning.

pav: For incident ops: I'm enabling rate-limit for extreme put sizes and pinning shard-22 to spare hosts. Rolling to canary now.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: PR #815 (batch clamp) -> canary sharding 5%

micah: When you reproduce, add `KV_RUN_HEAPDUMP=1` env to collect full snapshots. Use `kv-tool inspect-frag --shard=22` to get frag histogram.

jorge: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/kv/PR-815 1: implements batch-splitting. Tests included. Requesting fast-track.

lena: Good. Add a follow-up ticket to track whether batch-splitting regresses throughput for small writes. We should measure p99 and median.

adarsh: Creating dashboard panels: frag ratio, gc.pause, compaction-time, and CPU cost. New ticket KVR-242 created.

pav: Ops: canary at 5% for 30m with no OOMs so far. Increasing to 25%. Will keep shard pinning.

micah: Also proposing we add a weekly postmortem short-check: scan for kv-frag alerts and evaluate new model rollouts or code changes that coincided. Can someone volunteer to own recurring weekly scan?

lena: I'll own the weekly scan for the next 4 weeks. Adding calendar invite.

jorge: One more note: InsertBatcher instrumentation is sparse. I'll add allocation tags and a microbenchmark harness so we can compare allocations per op. ETA: EOW.

pav: ops note: created channel #kv-frag-watch for faster paging and created alert rule `kv.cache.frag_ratio > 0.45` -> page eng-runtime.

micah: Please add links to PRs and dashboards in INC-2026-0452 and set the postmortem owner after the incident is stable.

lena: Assign provisional postmortem to micah+jorge (co-owners). We'll finalize once the incident is quiet.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout PR #815 promoted to 25% -> no failures detected.

pav: Summary action items:
- jorge: add instrumentation + microbench (EOW)
- jorge: PR #815 batch-splitting (in canary)
- adarsh: compaction canary + dashboard KVR-242 (tomorrow morning)
- lena: weekly frag scan (4 weeks)
- pav: ops pinning + alerts + shard fallback plan

micah: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after adarsh's compaction results. Keep updates in the incident ticket and this thread. :thumbsup:
